ABOUT FIRMVAULT

Professional work.
Organised records.

FirmVault is a document management product by Nexosk Group Private Limited, designed around the way professional firms handle client documents.

A familiar way in. A consistent place to look.

CA firms, tax consultants, and law firms receive documents through conversations and employee forwarding. FirmVault brings those files into a central vault, organised by client, service, document type, and period.

Unclassified documents enter Pending for review. Teams search and retrieve their records centrally, keeping the document connected to the work it belongs to.

Start with your workflow.

A demo is a chance to talk through how your firm collects, files, and finds documents, and discuss what you need from the product.
